get.summary: Readiness: configuration loaded and port bound; never a shared dependency (§10.2).

put.summary: Replace the whole set of documents.

200.description: Applied, unchanged or refused as a whole; the status of every object

400.description: A document that names no kind or no valid name

401.description: Not a token of the cluster's issuer for this audience

403.description: The token of another workload than the configured operator

get.summary: List devices: your own, and those of the tenants you administer.

200.description: A web device this Authentik session already has

201.description: Registered; send its id in X-Kura-Device

401.description: Invalid token, or a session whose device was revoked

403.description: Not a member of any tenant

delete.summary: Revoke a device: yours, or one of a tenant you administer.

404.description: No such device you may revoke

post.summary:
Sign this browser out (RFC 0003 §6.2): the caller's own `web` device
stops counting as live and its id is refused as unknown. Unlike a
revocation it bans nothing: the same Authentik session may sign in again,
and the plugin or CLI it approved keep working (decision 24).

404.description: Not one of your web devices

get.summary: The signed-in caller: subject, tenant roles, platform admin flag.
A tenant's rules: all of them for an admin, a manager's vaults' for a manager.

403.description: Neither a tenant admin nor a vault manager

post.summary: Create a rule; the signing secret is in this answer only.

400.description: A URL that cannot be used, an unknown event, more than 20 rules

403.description: A tenant event or a rule without a vault, asked by a manager

put.summary: Change a rule; a re-enabled rule forgets its failures.

400.description: A URL that cannot be used, an unknown event

delete.summary: Delete a rule and its deliveries.

get.summary: The rule's last 50 deliveries, newest first (kept 7 days).

post.summary: Send `ping` to this rule now; the answer is the attempt's coarse result.

400.description: Invalid name, or the name is taken

delete.summary: Delete an API-managed vault (tenant admin): disabled now, purged after 30 days.

403.description: Not a tenant admin, or declared in configuration

get.summary:
The vault's bindings, from files and from the API (RFC 0003 §4.4): vault
manager or tenant admin.

put.summary: Bind a role on a vault (vault manager or tenant admin, §6.2).

delete.summary: Remove an API-managed binding (vault manager or tenant admin).

post.summary: Many file manifests in one call (RFC 0002 §4.4).

200.description: Manifests found, and the hashes that were not

400.description: No hash, more than 1,000, or one malformed

post.summary:
Many manifests in one call (RFC 0002 phase 3), with the checks of
`PUT /blobs/{hash}`: all stored, or none.

204.description: Every manifest stored, or already present

400.description: No manifest, more than 1,000, or a malformed hash

413.description: A file over the tenant's maxFileSize

422.description: A hash mismatch, a chunk missing, or sizes that disagree: nothing stored

put.summary: Store a file version's manifest; every chunk must already be present.

422.description: Hash mismatch, a chunk missing, or sizes that disagree

get.summary: Entries changed after a cursor, oldest first.

parameters.name: since
parameters.description: The last `seq` this device applied; 0 for a first sync.

parameters.name: epoch
parameters.description: The epoch the cursor was read under; a different one answers 410.

parameters.name: start
parameters.description:
The cursor this pass began from, when `since` is a later page of it:
the horizon is checked against it, since a pass from 0 crosses the
horizon page by page without having missed anything (absent: `since`).

parameters.name: folders
parameters.description:
Include folder entries (RFC 0007); a client that does not ask is
never sent one.

200.description: At most 1,000 entries; follow `next` for more

410.description: cursor_expired, or history_rewound: run a full resync

post.summary:
Many chunks in one answer, decrypted, at most 4 MiB of them (RFC 0002
§4.4): records `hash[32] status[1] length[4, big-endian] bytes`, status
0 found, 1 missing (unknown or not visible). Hashes past the budget are
left out; the client asks for them again.

200.description: Records in request order, up to 4 MiB of chunks

400.description: No hash, more than 1,000, or one malformed

429.description: Over 60 calls a minute, or this replica already builds 8 answers; retry after `Retry-After`

post.summary: Which of these chunks the vault lacks; present ones are kept from garbage collection.

Many chunks in one call (RFC 0002 phase 3): the records of `chunks/batch`,
every one found. Each chunk's BLAKE3 is checked before any is stored
(T7), as `put_chunk` checks one.

requestBody.description: 1 to 1,000 records `hash[32] 0 length[4, big-endian] bytes`, at most 4 MiB of chunks

204.description: Every chunk stored, or already present

400.description: A record cut short, missing, or no record

422.description: A chunk that is not its address (nothing stored), or quota exceeded

parameters.name: hash
parameters.description: BLAKE3 of the plaintext, lowercase hex

put.summary: Upload one chunk; its BLAKE3 must be its address.

parameters.name: hash
parameters.description: BLAKE3 of the plaintext, lowercase hex

post.summary: Push operations; each comes back accepted or conflicted (merged from phase 4).

200.description: One result per operation, in order

422.description: A forbidden path, a blob not uploaded, or an idempotency key reused with another body

get.summary: Every live entry, by id: what `kura attach` matches local files against.

parameters.name: after
parameters.description: The last entry id of the previous page.

parameters.name: profile
parameters.description:
With `space=config`: `desktop` or `mobile`. The console names one;
an Obsidian device may name only its own (RFC 0008 §4.3).

200.description: At most 1,000 entries; follow `next` for more. To the console, a hidden configuration file has no `blob` (RFC 0008)

400.description: A `profile` missing, unknown, or not this device's own

403.description: The configuration space for a scoped token

post.summary:
Restores a revision: a new revision with its content, through the commit
path, so the vault lock, `seq`, notifications and the conflict rules all
apply (§6.9). A deletion is not restorable: restore the revision before it.

403.description: Below editor; the console's device; or another profile's configuration (RFC 0008)

404.description: No such vault, entry or revision

parameters.name: before
parameters.description: The last `seq` of the previous page.

200.description: At most 1,000 revisions; follow `next` for older ones

get.summary: The vault's notifications, over a WebSocket opened with a ticket.

101.description: WebSocket: JSON `change`, `pull` and `ping` notices; closed 4003 for a used, expired or unknown ticket, 4004 for another vault's, 4001 when the token behind it expires, 4002 on revocation, 4005 when the caller no longer reads the vault, 4008 past 4 sockets, 4009 when too slow

429.description: Over 60 attempts a minute from this address

post.summary: A ticket for this device and vault.

Full-text and file-name search in one vault (§6.7): the query travels in
the body, never the URL (T19).

409.description: search_disabled: the tenant has no index

get.summary:
The devices syncing a vault: every one for its managers and the tenant's
admins, the caller's own for anyone else who reads it.

404.description: No such vault, or not readable

put.summary:
Report what this device's last run left on its side: counts only, never
paths (RFC 0006 phase 3). A device's own row; a scoped token is refused.

400.description: Not four counts, or one over 1,000,000

404.description: No such vault, or not readable

get.summary: The vault's tokens, newest first; never a secret.

post.summary: Issues a token for this vault; the secret is in this answer only.

400.description: No address range, a /0 range, a bad prefix, rule, name or expiry

409.description: token_write_disabled: a write rule, and the tenant does not allow tokens to write

delete.summary: Revokes a token at once, on every replica (the next use is refused).

generation.description: SHA-256 of the stored files, hex; absent before the first reconciliation.

objects.description: One entry per declared or removed object, `Ready` condition first.

rejection.description: This replica's last rejected change, `file#index path: message`.

Author.description:
The device or scoped token that wrote a revision, never the person's
identity provider subject.

emptyFolders.description:
RFC 0005 §4.3: the bound folders under which no note exists yet
(filled by the listing only).

paths.description: The folders a restricted viewer reads; absent: the whole vault.

widened.description:
RFC 0005 §4.3: folders listed, but the tenant maps this group to
`owner` or `admin`, so the whole vault is open to it anyway.

blobs.description: Blob hashes, 64 lowercase hex characters each, 1 to 1,000.

manifests.description: The manifests found, in request order.

missing.description: Unknown or not visible to the caller: the same answer for both.

manifests.description: 1 to 1,000 manifests, each under its address.

epoch.description: Changes when the server loses history (§6.3); send it back with `since`.

headSeq.description: The head this page was read against, in the same snapshot.

next.description: Set when more pages follow: the next `since` (changes) or `after` (entries).

authorization.description: Sent as the `Authorization` header; never shown again.

url.description: `https`, public or allowed by the operator; never shown again.

chunks.description: Chunk hashes, 64 lowercase hex characters each, 1 to 1,000.

epoch.description:
The epoch this device's state was built under: another one answers
`410 history_rewound` (§6.3). Absent on a first push.

idempotencyKey.description: Unique per device for 7 days; a retry reuses it with the same body.

space.description:
`config`: the caller's own Obsidian configuration for its device's
profile (§6.8); absent: the notes.

vault.description: A vault of the tenant; absent: the whole tenant (admins only).

cidrs.description: Client addresses allowed, at least one; never `0.0.0.0/0` or `::/0`.

name.description:
1 to 64 bytes, shown in lists and conflict file names; absent:
`key-` and the first 8 characters of the id.

prefix.description:
One `read` rule, as before RFC 0004; refused together with `scopes`.
Neither: the whole vault, read only.

name.description: An RFC 1123 label, unique in the tenant.

owner.description: The owner's subject, shown only to a tenant admin for others' devices.

ownerName.description:
The owner's name as their identity provider gives it, beside `owner`
(RFC 0006 D13); absent until the owner's device was seen with one.

vaults.description:
The vaults this device caught up on (RFC 0006), for the caller's own
devices only.

DeviceReport.description: The counts a device reported, and when.

behind.description:
Notes it may read changed since; absent until it finished a pass or
when `resync` is set. Capped at 1,001, read as "1,000+".

caughtUpAt.description: RFC 3339; absent until the device finished a pass.

owner.description: The owner's subject: only in a manager's or tenant admin's answer.

ownerName.description: The owner's name, beside `owner` only (RFC 0006 D13).

oneOf.description:
What the device's last run left on its side (phase 3); absent until
a client that reports has run.

resync.description: The vault lost history since: the device runs a full resync next.

DeviceVault.description: One vault a device follows, and when it last caught up on it.

allOf.description: The stored configuration after this push: the last valid one when refused.

applied.description: Whether this push changed the stored configuration.

errors.description:
Why the set was refused, each with the document it names
(`location.file` is `KuraTenant/<name>` or `KuraVault/<namespace>/<name>`).

EntryId.description: A stable entry id, chosen by the client: a UUIDv7 (§6.3).

EntryState.description: An entry's current state, as `changes` and commit results return it.

folder.description:
A folder (RFC 0007): no blob, size 0. Sent only to a client that
asked for folders.

token.description: `kura_<id>_<secret>`: shown once, never stored in clear.

name.description: `name`, else `preferred_username`, as the identity provider sent it.

tenants.description: The tenants the caller belongs to; a binding alone makes a member.

hashes.description: Chunk hashes, 64 lowercase hex characters each, at most 1,000.

missing.description: The requested hashes the vault does not hold, in request order.

OpResult.description: The result of one operation, in request order.

oneOf.description: The conflict file holding the pushed content, when one was created.

head.description:
The pushed entry as it now stands. For a new entry unified with an
identical one at the same path, that other entry.

oneOf.description: Create (no `base`) or update an entry: its content, its path, or both.

base.description: The revision this edit started from; absent for a new entry.

blob.description: The blob address (`blob_hash`) of the content, already uploaded.

oneOf.description: Delete an entry, as of the revision the client last saw.

Create (no `base`) or move a folder: an entry with no content
(RFC 0007). A rename is a delete and a create.

Operation.description: One operation of a commit. A rename is a `put` with another path.

type.description: Relative URI under `/v1/problems/`, stable across releases.

paths.description:
`viewer` only: 1 to 16 folders ending with `/`; absent: the whole
vault (RFC 0005).

role.description: `viewer`, `editor` or `manager`, at most your own role.

name.description: Shown in device lists and conflict file names, 1 to 64 bytes.

RestoreRequest.description: `POST /vaults/{v}/entries/{e}/restore`: a new revision with this one's content.

RevisionInfo.description: One stored revision of an entry (`GET …/entries/{e}/revisions`, §4.4).

oneOf.description:
Who wrote it, by the name readers may see (RFC 0005 §4.5); absent
from servers before it, or when the device was purged.

next.description: Set when older revisions follow: the next `before`.

host.description: The URL's host: all that is shown of it after creation (§4.5).

ScopeRule.description: One folder rule: the folder and everything under it.

path.description: A folder ending with `/`; `""` is the whole vault, `read` only.

snippet.description: Text around the first match; absent past the decryption budget.

query.description: Web search syntax (`"exact phrase"`, `-word`, `or`); at least 2 characters.

SyncCounts.description:
`PUT /vaults/{v}/sync/report` (RFC 0006 phase 3): what the device's last
run left on its side, as counts only, never paths.

failed.description: Remote files the device could not write; retried next run.

pending.description:
Local changes not sent: refused by role or quota, or outside what the
caller may write.

unsyncable.description: Local files that cannot sync (a name or size rule).

role.description: `member`, `admin` or `owner`: the highest role the caller's claims map to.

result.description:
The coarse result of the one attempt: a status, or `timeout`,
`connect`, `tls`, `address_refused`, `redirect`, `status_4xx`, `status_5xx`.

ticket.description: Single use, valid `expiresIn` seconds; send as `?ticket=`.

prefix.description:
As before RFC 0004: the folder of a token with one `read` rule, `/`
(which matches no path) for any other.

authorization.description: A new value; `""` removes it; absent: kept.

enabled.description: `true` re-enables a rule and forgets its failures.

rotateSecret.description: A new signing secret, returned once.

chunking.description: FastCDC parameters in bytes; clients never use a compiled-in value (§6.4).

configSync.description: The Obsidian configuration categories that sync (§6.8); empty: none.

groups.description:
For whoever may bind on this vault (its manager, a tenant admin): the
claim values the tenant maps, the only groups a binding may name
(RFC 0003 §4.5, Add access).

paths.description:
For a restricted viewer: the folders they read (RFC 0005 §4.2);
absent: the whole vault.

scopes.description:
For a scoped token: its own folder rules (RFC 0004), so its client
refuses a change outside them before sending it. Absent for a device.

tokenName.description: For a scoped token: its own name, which its client shows (RFC 0004 §4.5).

updatedAt.description:
When `headSeq` was written, RFC 3339 (RFC 0005 §4.5, "updated");
absent before the first commit or once that revision is purged.

bearer_token.description: OIDC access token from Authentik, verified per RFC8725: pinned algorithms, issuer, audience, expiry and the `scope` claim

ws_ticket.name: ticket
ws_ticket.description: From POST /vaults/{v}/events/ticket: 256 random bits, single use, 30 s
